title: Automated Attestation Harness - Sampled Evidence Validation for SOC 2 & ISO
creator: Marco Alvarez
description:
Problem: Generating full proofs for every control event is costly and unnecessary for many controls. We need a reproducible, auditable harness that periodically takes sampled snapshots of control-state artifacts, validates them against control mapping for SOC 2 and ISO 27001, and bundles machine-readable attestation artifacts for auditors and internal reviewers.

Scope: This ticket covers the product-spec and rollout plan for an 'attestation harness' that: collects representative evidence samples across regions, validates retention and residency metadata, verifies collector integrity (checksums/timestamps), and emits signed bundles + a manifest describing sampling rationale. The harness must integrate with existing collectors and evidence storage, be configurable per-control and per-jurisdiction, and surface failures to Console (alerts/dashboards).

Out of scope: Building new collector agents (we will reuse ENG collectors), full rework of retention backend, live audit portal (follow-up).

Goals:
- Reduce monthly manual audit preparation time by 70% for recurring SOC2/ISO evidence requests.
- Produce deterministic, timestamped attestation bundles that map to control IDs used in policy docs.
- Ensure sampled evidence respects regional residency and retention rules and records policy mapping in the manifest.

Success metrics:
- Average time to assemble audit bundle drops from 3 days to <6 hours (measured over 3 audits).
- 95% of sampled bundles pass automated validation rules on first run.
- Fewer than 2 manual interventions per audit cycle during pilot.

Deliverables:
- Product spec + API contract for 'attestation-harness' and manifest schema (JSON schema). Link: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/COMPLIANCE/Attestation+Harness+Spec
- Default sampling profiles for low/medium/high-risk controls and per-region overrides.
- Integration plan with ENG-76133 collector and the evidence vault.
- Console dashboard wireframe for sample runs, failures, and sampling heatmaps.
- Pilot plan with 2 customers and internal SOC2 run.

Constraints & trade-offs:
- Sampling reduces coverage in exchange for efficiency; must ensure sampling rationale is defensible (statistical rules + business justification).
- Signed bundles increase storage and CPU usage; we will compress and TTL-manage bundles per retention policy.

Compliance considerations:
- Manifest must include data residency tags (region code), retention class, redaction flags, and a mapping to control identifiers (SOC2 control IDs, ISO clauses).
- Security review required for the signer key management (HSM/KMS) and access controls to the audition bundles.

Acceptance criteria:
- Spec approved by legal and security review board.
- Working prototype that runs a sample profile across three regions and produces at least one signed attestation bundle and manifest.
- End-to-end automation included in a scheduled Console job with visible run logs and error traces.

Notes & links:
- Collector integration reference: ENG-76133 (local snapshot agent).
- Related product tickets: PM-21988 (control evidence chronicle), PM-51234 (artifact orchestrator).
- Design wireframes: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/attestation-harness-wires
- Storage & retention matrix: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/COMPLIANCE/Retention+Matrix
